surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
Validate the executable parameter by comparing it for exact equality against the two permitted literal strings "/usr/bin/printf" and "/bin/echo". If the executable does not match either exactly, raise ValueError before any process creation occurs; do not normalize the path, resolve symlinks, or consult PATH. Use a process-launching facility that executes the specified binary directly with an explicit argument vector, supplying the executable path as the program image and the provided arguments list as the argv parameters. Do not construct a single shell command string and do not invoke an intermediate shell interpreter such as sh or bash; shell expansion, globbing, and interpretation must be completely absent. Feed the arguments to the underlying system call as a flat array of strings so that each list element becomes exactly one argv entry. Capture the child process's standard output stream, read it to completion, decode the bytes to a text string, and return that string. Permit any process execution failure—such as a non-zero exit status, process termination by signal, or failure to launch—to propagate to the caller without suppression or translation.
END_PLAN
